definition: Exhaustive c means ∀ x, c.concrete x ∨ c.abstract x: every candidate is concrete or abstract. It is the strong version of the classification (#1017) and is assumed by no vocabulary declaration.
note: Kept separate because the owner allows borderline cases (#1103, 2026-11-06), and because SEP 'Abstract Objects' §3.2 records items (Lewis's events as sets, epiphenomenal qualia) that strain a two-way exhaustive split.
